question: Select the most appropriate option for blank (5)
solution:
The correct answer is: **encircled**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"encircled"** means to surround something or someone completely, often forming a circle around it. (घेर लिया हुआ)

 
 
• **Example: **The army encircled the enemy camp, cutting off all escape routes.
 
 
 
• The context tells us that a massive cloud of dust would have been created by the collision, rising into the sky and circling the globe.
 
• Hence, we can infer that the correct word for the blank is **'encircled'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 2** i.e. encircled.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Walled **(दीवार से घिरा हुआ): Surrounded by a wall or walls.

 
 
• **Example:** The walled garden was a peaceful retreat from the bustling city.
 
 
 
• **Fenced **(बाड़ से घिरा हुआ): Enclosed or surrounded with a fence.
 
 
• **Example: **The farmer fenced his property to keep the livestock from wandering off.
 
 
 
• **Captured** (कब्जा किया हुआ): To take into one's possession or control by force.
 
 
• **Example:** The soldiers captured the fort after a long battle.
